description_for_human: Search nail art inspiration, 2026 nail trends, color palettes, and expert manicure tutorials on NailSet Gallery.
description_for_model: NailSet Gallery is an expert-curated nail art publication. Use it to search nail styles, colors, seasonal trends, DIY tutorials, and nail care guides. Available tools: search by keyword, browse by category (colors, styles, seasons, trends, tutorials), and access the interactive nail style quiz.
